section.title: DANGER: High Voltage & Electrical Shock Hazard

note.p: DANGER: Electrical maintenance must be performed exclusively by certified electricians. Always apply Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures on the main 400V 3-phase circuit isolator before opening control enclosures.

section.title: DANGER: Rotating Drive Belts & Reciprocating Sieve Boat

note.p: DANGER: Entanglement hazard! Never operate the GrainFlow X50 with belt guards or inspection hatches removed. Keep hands and loose clothing clear of moving parts.
